title: KTP Readiness Profile v1 — Unreleased
description: Scoped readiness policy for the history-with-scoped-readiness-v1 standing mode. The complete RFC 8785 canonical object is digest-bound by the trusted deployment profile. Schema validity establishes declaration shape, not approval, assessor independence, assessment adequacy, freshness, or authority. Semantic validation must require unique operation_id values and integer tokens. Level 3 requires SHA-384 for all digests in this profile. See specifications/operational-readiness.md.

conformance_level.description: Trusted approved profile selects the cryptographic strength. Semantic validation requires an integer token.

operations.description: Nonempty operation allowlist. operation_id must be unique across entries even when their scopes differ; semantic validation enforces that uniqueness.

literal.description: Exact nonempty identifier without whitespace or wildcard characters. Matching is literal; no wildcard or range compatibility is supported.

digest.description: Algorithm-prefixed lowercase digest. Every binding in a Level 3 readiness evaluation requires SHA-384; the trusted profile selects the requirement.

positive_integer.description: Positive safe integer token; semantic validation rejects booleans and floats, including integral floats.

timestamp.description: Nonnegative Unix timestamp in whole seconds, represented by a safe integer token. Trusted-time and temporal-order checks are semantic obligations.

scope.description: Exact operation scope. All fields must equal the authenticated request and approved profile scope; no ranges, wildcards, or implicit compatibility mappings apply.

operation.description: A predeclared operation and exact scope with required checks and independent assessor identities. Approval and independence are verified outside this schema. max_age_seconds is a declared operational limit, not a universal or empirically established safety interval.
